rules.label: Return address required
rules.description: Every envelope needs a full sender name and postal address or it is refused.

rules.label: Full name and number
rules.description: Address mail with the prisoner's full legal name and inmate number; nicknames are not delivered.

rules.label: Plain envelopes only
rules.description: White or manila envelopes with no stickers, tape, drawings, or coloured ink.

rules.label: No stickers or labels
rules.description: Address labels, stickers, and stamps other than postage are not allowed on the envelope.

rules.label: One letter per envelope
rules.description: Envelopes containing letters for more than one prisoner are returned.

rules.label: Registered post recommended
rules.description: Ordinary international post is often lost; send letters by registered or tracked mail.

rules.label: Plain paper only
rules.description: White lined or unlined paper; no cardstock, construction paper, or scented paper.

rules.label: Blue or black ink only
rules.description: Letters written in pencil, marker, crayon, or coloured ink are rejected.

rules.label: Typed letters allowed
rules.description: Typed and printed letters are accepted as long as the pages are unbound.

rules.label: Handwritten letters only
rules.description: Typed or printed letters are refused; write by hand.

rules.label: Postcards only
rules.description: This facility accepts standard-size postcards only; enclosed letters are returned.

rules.label: No greeting cards
rules.description: Cards with layers, glitter, pop-ups, or musical parts are refused; a flat card is accepted.

rules.label: No perfume or lipstick
rules.description: Scented, stained, or lipstick-marked paper is treated as contaminated and destroyed.

rules.label: No glue, tape, or staples
rules.description: Nothing may be glued, taped, or stapled to the pages.

rules.label: No maps
rules.description: Maps, including hand-drawn ones, are treated as escape material and confiscated.

rules.label: No coded messages
rules.description: Letters containing ciphers, symbols, or unexplained abbreviations are held for investigation.

rules.label: No drawings by others
rules.description: Hand-drawn artwork is accepted only from the sender; drawings by children or others are refused.

rules.label: No third-party mail
rules.description: Mail that forwards or relays a message from someone else is refused.

rules.label: No pictures
rules.description: Letters must be text only; photographs and printed images are returned.

rules.label: No polaroids
rules.description: Instant-film photographs are refused because the backing can hide contraband.

rules.label: No nude or suggestive photos
rules.description: Photographs showing nudity, underwear, or sexually suggestive poses are destroyed.

rules.label: No gang signs in photos
rules.description: Photographs showing hand signs, gang colours, or gang tattoos are refused.

rules.label: Nothing enclosed
rules.description: Nothing may be enclosed with a letter: no stamps, cash, cards, or objects of any kind.

rules.label: Stamps not accepted
rules.description: Enclosed postage stamps are confiscated; stamps must be bought at the commissary.

rules.label: No money orders
rules.description: Funds cannot be sent by mail; use the facility's deposit service.

rules.label: No newspaper clippings
rules.description: Cuttings and printed articles are refused; write out or describe the content instead.

rules.label: Printed internet pages allowed
rules.description: Printed web pages are accepted if they are plain black-and-white text with no images.

rules.label: Books from publishers only
rules.description: Books must ship new from a publisher or approved bookseller, never from an individual.

rules.label: Paperbacks only
rules.description: Hardcover books are refused; send paperback editions.

rules.label: No unknown senders
rules.description: Only senders on the prisoner's approved correspondence list are delivered.

rules.label: Sender approval form
rules.description: New correspondents must file the facility's approval form before their first letter is delivered.

rules.label: No mail between prisoners
rules.description: Correspondence with anyone held in another facility requires prior written approval.

rules.label: Mail opened and read
rules.description: All incoming mail except legal mail is opened and read by staff before delivery.

rules.label: Legal mail marked clearly
rules.description: Mail from a lawyer must be marked Legal Mail with the firm's address or it is opened as ordinary mail.

rules.label: Scanned, not delivered
rules.description: Incoming mail is scanned by a vendor and shown on a tablet; the paper original is destroyed.

rules.label: Scanned mail: no colour
rules.description: Because mail is scanned in greyscale, colour drawings and photos arrive as black and white.

rules.label: Digital mail only
rules.description: Letters must be sent through the facility's electronic mail service; postal mail is returned.

rules.label: Delivery not confirmed
rules.description: The facility does not confirm delivery; expect delays of four to eight weeks.

rules.label: Holiday mail limits
rules.description: In December only, up to two cards per sender are accepted.

pageLimit.label: Page limit
pageLimit.description: Letters over this many single-sided pages are returned. Null means no limit.

photoLimit.label: Photo limit
photoLimit.description: The most loose photographs one envelope may hold. Null means no stated limit; a facility that takes none has the no_photos tag instead.

mailLanguages.label: Accepted languages
mailLanguages.description: Mail must be written in one of these languages. Null or empty means no restriction.
